correctness.rationale: The identity x^5+y^5=s^5(1-5u+5u^2), u=xy/s^2, gives a two-discriminant involution on every s != 0. The quadratic-character hyperbola identity is proved independently; removing its fixed point and endpoints gives exactly all five integer fiber multiplicities. The zero row is q at the origin and zero elsewhere, and Parseval/character orthogonality yields fourth moment equal to energy/q^2. Direct exhaustive integer checks on 11 fields, including 49 and 121, and independent complex Fourier evaluations on 7,11,13 agree. Uniform proof does not use finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The complete ordered-pair convolution histogram for the natural fifth-power finite-field Fourier curve distinguishes both chi(-1) and chi(-2), while its aggregate energy has a different and unexpectedly simpler mod-four law. The uniform extension-field classification supplies exact Fourier fourth moments for constant data and reveals geometry unavailable from general boundedness results; it is not an arbitrary parameter slice or a restatement of the quartic or cubic graph results.
